source_checks.finding: February 24 2022 primary notice states a national male 18–60 outward restriction during martial law; no finite gate roster or control-line geometry.
August 27 2025 primary explanation permits men 18–22 subject to documents and office-holder exceptions; not a full reopening.
Indexed current primary rules retain category-specific 23–60 exceptions and amendment provenance; current text does not reconstruct every earlier exemption version.
